name: The Mining Company
archetype: A hard-rock mine and mill — geology, mining operations, processing, tailings

ca.full: Provincial Ministry of Mines (e.g. BC MEMLI / Ontario MLITSD)
ca.what: Mine permits, operating licences and the mine-safety code — inspections, stop-work orders and permit amendments.
Federal environmental enforcement — metal and diamond mining effluent regulations, fisheries protection and species at risk.
Federal impact assessment of designated mining projects — expansions, new pits and tailings facilities.

uk.what: Safety enforcement under the Mines Regulations 2014 — mine plans, ventilation, escape and rescue arrangements.
Environmental permits for discharges, mining-waste facilities and water abstraction.
Licensing of coal workings, mine-water treatment and subsidence liability.

roles.title: Board of Directors
roles.about: Elected by shareholders to govern the company. Sets strategy and risk appetite, approves capital projects and the annual reserve and resource statement, and holds the CEO to account. Works through its Audit, Safety Health Environment & Communities, Technical & Reserves and Compensation committees.
acc: Ultimate accountability for safe, responsible mining and shareholder value
Approval of strategy, major capital projects and the reserve statement
Oversight of tailings, safety and community performance through its committees
